verdict.rationale: WorkOS documents RBAC with custom roles, permissions, and organization-scoped roles enforced through session JWTs. Organization-scoped roles are a coarse, tenant-level step beyond global roles. The docs mention 'enforce access policies at scale' without describing any relationship-based or policy-based engine. Nothing in the evidence shows per-resource authorization beyond role assignment. missing for 10: relationship-based (ReBAC/FGA) authorization, attribute- or policy-based rules, per-resource permission checks below the organization level, independent corroboration.
